headline.detail: the legacy materialisation was produced by a PYTHON engine, not the Pine indicator. That engine uses a fixed numerical epsilon of 1e-10 as a divide-by-zero guard.
headline.consequence: no per-symbol tick metadata exists to obtain, no venue disambiguation is needed, and no regulatory MPV question arises — no trading increment enters the computation at all

authority.located_not_assumed: both call sites pass the config constants; no caller overrides
authority.hierarchy_rank: pre-empts the TradingView search entirely — the value is not a tick size and TradingView is not its authority

source_verification.epsilon_not_tick: 1e-10 is a divide-by-zero guard, not a trading increment

supersedes_amendment_1_requirement.amendment_1_demanded: an authoritative point-in-time tick-size source with effective_from / effective_to per security
supersedes_amendment_1_requirement.why_that_was_wrong: it presumed the materialisation evaluated syminfo.mintick. It did not. The requirement was built on a Pine construct the legacy pipeline never used.
supersedes_amendment_1_requirement.user_correction_acknowledged: syminfo.mintick is symbol-level static metadata in Pine, not a per-bar PIT series — and here it is not used at all
supersedes_amendment_1_requirement.amendment_1_disposition: remains an immutable HOLD artifact; not edited
supersedes_amendment_1_requirement.no_fallback_rule: not violated — 1e-10 is not a fallback, it is the frozen authoritative value from the implementation that produced the column

correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.severity: MATERIAL — this corrects the recovery artifact's comparison, not just a detail
correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.what_i_did: treated the Pine script as the authority and measured recovered Pine semantics against the materialised column, reporting 99.14% and characterising the residual
correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.what_was_already_frozen: raw_T4(current_store_OHLC) == materialized_canonical_T4 — the two sides do not share an input vintage
correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.valid_invariant: identical input bars + identical config + identical implementation => raw_T4 == canonical_T4
correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.meaning: under the valid invariant the legacy engine reproduces its own column EXACTLY (78,181/78,181, 0 mismatches). My 0.86% residual was not a semantic gap — it was the invalid comparison a frozen artifact had already retired.
correction_to_my_own_prior_framing.recovery_artifact_disposition: MASSIVE_T_PINE_SEMANTIC_RECOVERY_V1 (7d00e3908feb26d5) remains immutable; its Pine extraction is correct and independently useful, but its conformance FRAMING should be read alongside this correction

signal_logic.doji_thresh: present as a parameter, UNUSED in is_doji

which_is_the_materialiser.evidence: exact-equality doji reproduces the materialised column at 99.14%; threshold doji reproduces it at 98.10%
which_is_the_materialiser.measured_on: legacy daily bars, deduplicated, full population

frozen_artifact_citation_issue.claim: isDoji = (close == open) EXACTLY; doji_thresh=0.05 exists as a parameter but does not participate in isDoji (verified in source)
frozen_artifact_citation_issue.problem: the claim describes signal_logic.py's behaviour while citing signal_engine.py, which does use the threshold
frozen_artifact_citation_issue.assessment: the CLAIM is supported by the data; the CITATION appears to point at the wrong file

repo_inconsistency_found.why_it_matters: isDoji feeds prev1IsBear, which gates T1, T3, T5, T9 and T1G — most of the family. Which implementation a future port binds is a material choice and is not mine to make.

per_security_binding.model: a single scalar constant, not a per-security table
per_security_binding.why: the value is implementation-level, not instrument-level

legacy_runtime_status.LEGACY_RUNTIME_MINTICK: KNOWN — 1e-10, from the implementation that produced the column
legacy_runtime_status.note: this is a stronger statement than Amendment 1 could make, because the authority turned out to be the materialising code itself rather than external metadata

regulatory_consistency_audit.reason: not applicable — 1e-10 is an epsilon guard, so comparing it to an exchange minimum price variation would be a category error
regulatory_consistency_audit.not_collected: SEC Rule 612 / venue MPV values were not adopted or compared

timestamp_alignment.rule: legacy.date == Massive.bar_start, exact, UTC bar start

price_basis.note: exact 2-decimal rounding equivalence demonstrated on limited matched evidence only

decision_required.summary: the mintick gap is closed, but the inventory raised a question that must be answered before the port proceeds
decision_required.question: which implementation is the authoritative semantic target for the Massive port — signal_logic.py (exact-equality doji, matches the materialisation) or the Pine indicator (also exact-equality, but a sibling implementation)?
decision_required.secondary: whether the T4_ENGULF_CONFIG_V1 source citation should be corrected by its own amendment

next_step: a narrow amendment binding mintick=1e-10 and resolving the implementation authority question. Smoke remains not started.
